protocol: Same-interpreter two-arm bitwise parity over the una pairing-workflow surface (Logger / betweenness_flow_simulation / KNN_accessibility). Reference arm: upstream madina imported inside .refs/venv_madina_legacy; facade arm: urban_network_analysis.compat.madina.una.workflows imported in the SAME interpreter/venv. Every scenario runs the reference TWICE (the first execution populates the shared scenario cache, the determinism control in test_scenario_bitwise_parity re-executes it fresh — a deliberate cache bypass fixed post-review, F1) then the facade once; the facade digest must equal the reference digest BITWISE (IEEE-754 hex of every float via struct.pack('>d'), WKB/WKT content sha256 for geometries, dtypes/categories, insertion orders, time_log event sequences in order, error type+message verbatim). Source-patch mutants are exec'd clones of EACH arm's OWN workflows.py (replacement count asserted == 1 in both arms); integrity = mutant-facade == mutant-reference, selection = mutant != clean.
